title: Why do prices go up? (explained like you're 5)

sources.claim: Central banks raise policy rates to slow demand and bring inflation down
Inflation = general rise in prices, measured e.g. by CPI

style.character: Maya, a woman in her late 20s, shoulder-length black hair, mustard-yellow jacket, warm brown skin, expressive face
style.look: cinematic, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text overlays, no logos
style.illustration_style: children's picture book illustration, soft gouache and colored pencil texture, bright cheerful candy colors, thick friendly outlines, rounded cute shapes, simple uncluttered background, warm sunny light, vertical 9:16 composition, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no words

cast.bruno: Bruno, a friendly round brown bear baker wearing a white apron and a tiny white chef hat
cast.kids: three happy kids: a girl with a red bow, a boy with a blue cap, and a small girl in a yellow raincoat
cast.piggy: Big Piggy, a giant pink piggy bank wearing a small gold crown

scenes.narration: Mom's shopping cart costs more than last year. Why?

visual.motion_prompt: [Push in] She looks from the receipt to the price tags on the shelf, eyebrows rising in disbelief, subtle handheld camera movement

scenes.narration: Imagine a tiny town with only a few cookies.

visual.prompt: {bruno} stands behind a cute bakery stall with a small tray of a few round cookies on a tray, {kids} look at the cookies with big smiles, medium wide shot, sunny village street

scenes.narration: One day, everyone gets lots of extra coins!

visual.prompt: {kids} cheer while holding overflowing bags of shiny gold coins, golden coins raining down around them, confetti, joyful, medium shot, sunny village street

scenes.narration: Everybody wants cookies, but there are only a few! So Bruno says, cookies cost more now.

visual.prompt: {kids} crowd eagerly around the bakery stall waving coins, {bruno} holds up a plain wooden sign that has only one bold arrow pointing up drawn on it, no writing on the sign, he looks apologetic, only a few cookies on the tray, medium wide shot

scenes.narration: When prices keep going up like that, grown-ups call it inflation.

visual.prompt: a tall stack of gold coins growing taller next to a single cookie, {bruno} gently smiling in the background, simple clean composition, close shot

scenes.narration: So the boss of the Big Piggy Bank says, borrowing coins now costs extra. That extra is called an interest rate.

visual.prompt: {piggy} stands proudly and gestures with one hoof to {kids}, one child holds out an empty hand asking to borrow coins, a small extra coin is being added onto the pile, medium shot, sunny village street

scenes.narration: Now fewer kids borrow coins, fewer cookies get bought, and Bruno stops raising his price.

visual.prompt: {kids} walk away calmly with coins safely in their pockets, {bruno} smiles happily behind the stall with a few cookies left on the tray, calm peaceful mood, medium wide shot

scenes.narration: But when prices climb, your coins buy fewer cookies. That's why grown-ups worry.

visual.prompt: the small girl in a yellow raincoat looks worriedly at one gold coin in her palm and a big cookie that looks far away, thought bubble shows her tiny piggy bank, soft worried mood, close shot

scenes.narration: So when you hear, rates are going up, they're just keeping prices from running away!

visual.motion_prompt: [Pull out] She exhales with relief and gives a small satisfied nod, gentle camera drift

scenes.narration: Now you know! Follow for more big questions, in tiny words.

visual.prompt: {bruno} waves happily at the viewer holding a warm cookie, {kids} wave behind him, big smiles, bright celebratory mood, sparkles, medium shot

carousel.h: A tiny town has only a few cookies.
One day, everyone gets extra coins!
More coins, same cookies. Cookies cost more!
The Big Piggy Bank makes borrowing cost extra.
Fewer cookies bought. Prices calm down.
Prices climbing means coins buy less. That is why grown-ups worry.
